_comment: The eight rows of the hand-curated model iteration log the group submitted, transcribed from Task6/Y2A_model_iteration_log.xlsx in the private group repository. The spreadsheet has forty numbered rows; thirty-two are empty. Transcribed rather than committed as-is because a binary spreadsheet cannot be read in a diff, and because only these fields carry numbers. Everything under 'recorded' is copied from the sheet verbatim. Two fields are DERIVED, not recorded, and are marked as such: 'model_name' is inferred from the row's own hyperparameters (solver=lbfgs -> logistic regression, alpha -> multinomial naive Bayes, dual=False -> LinearSVC, lstm_dropout -> LSTM, gru_dropout -> GRU, and the two transformers name their checkpoints), and 'neutral_cap' is the Neutral class ceiling read out of the row's own preprocessing string, which check_consistency asserts against that string. The sheet's plain 'Precision', 'Recall' and 'F1 score' columns are recorded here under weighted names because recall equals accuracy in all eight rows, which is only true of weighted averaging; check_consistency asserts that identity. The per-row f1_macro and training time come from the sheet's free-text 'Other metrics' column.
_split_comment: There is no test split. Every metric below is a validation score on the same 15% the runs were tuned against.
